title: Maximum Sum With Exactly K Elements
accessAttempt: WebFetch on the official page returns 403; constraints and examples taken from WebSearch result text citing the LeetCode problem page.
summary: Given nums and k, perform exactly k operations; each picks an element m, adds m to the score, and replaces it with m + 1. Return the maximum score.
visualizationNotes: Constraints are already within the visualization cap (100 elements, k <= 100).
